description_good_justification: README and docs/START_HERE.md describe a FOSS GitHub template that gives coding agents a shared AGENTS.md contract, CI, and a Golden Path.
interact_justification: README Obtain / feedback / contribute; SUPPORT.md; CONTRIBUTING.md; SECURITY.md.
documentation_interface_justification: CLI/API interfaces: examples/node OpenAPI at GET /openapi.json; examples/python --openapi / --help; examples/web README commands; Android MODULE.md.
english_justification: Docs and issue templates are English.
maintained_justification: Active 2026 maintenance; weekly SECURITY_TRIAGE.md; latest release v1.1.0.
repo_interim_justification: GitHub branches and pull requests between releases.
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning via Release Please and CHANGELOG.md.
version_tags_justification: git tags such as v1.1.0 on GitHub Releases.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known runtime CVEs with assignments in template releases to date.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues with Bug / Crash / Feature / Template Improvement forms.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No private vulnerability reports received in the last 6 months.
build_justification: scripts/verify.sh; examples/web npm run build; Android Gradle; Python/Node/Rust/Go examples.
build_common_tools_justification: npm, uv, Gradle, cargo, go — all FLOSS toolchains.
build_floss_tools_justification: Build uses only FLOSS tools; no proprietary SDKs on the FOSS path.
test_justification: python3 -m unittest / uv pytest; npm test; ./gradlew test. Documented in AGENTS.md and stack READMEs.
test_invocation_justification: Standard per stack: npm test, uv run pytest, ./gradlew test, cargo test, go test.
test_most_justification: Unit tests per stack plus Playwright/axe; not 100% branch coverage but core Golden Path is covered.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: .github/workflows/ci.yml Feature Gate and stack jobs on push/PR to main.
report_responses_justification: GitHub Issues enabled; no unreplied bug reports in the last 2-12 months.
enhancement_responses_justification: Feature Request / Ideas forms; no unreplied enhancement requests in the last 2-12 months.
test_policy_justification: AGENTS.md test-first; CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests with features.
tests_are_added_justification: Each AGENT feature adds tests/ or stack tests (see docs/features/).
warnings_justification: ruff, Biome, mypy, Android lint, shellcheck, CodeQL.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI Feature Gate fails on lint/type errors.
warnings_strict_justification: Android lint IDs are errors; Biome/ruff in CI.
crypto_published_justification: Template does not implement cryptographic protocols; transport is GitHub HTTPS.
crypto_random_justification: Does not generate cryptographic keys or nonces.
delivery_unsigned_justification: GitHub Releases over HTTPS only; no http hash-only delivery.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: HIGH/CRITICAL halt /update-deps apply; triage before release.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Gitleaks pre-commit and CI; .env is gitignored.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL, Semgrep (FOSS), ruff, Biome, Android lint.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Confirmed findings are fixed or dismissed in DECISION_LOG.md / SECURITY_TRIAGE.md.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL and CI lint on every push/PR to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Playwright + axe on the web Golden Path; Android instrumented tests when an SDK is present.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No C/C++ in the production path.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: CI fails on failing Playwright/unit tests.
OSPS-AC-01.01_justification: GitHub requires MFA for users since 2023.
OSPS-AC-02.01_justification: GitHub collaborator invites require a role; default is not admin.
OSPS-BR-01.01_justification: scripts/check-ci-refs.sh validates workflow_dispatch release tags before use.
OSPS-BR-01.02_justification: CI and Release validate GITHUB_REF_NAME via scripts/check-ci-refs.sh.
OSPS-LE-03.02_justification: LICENSE is in the tagged source tree.
OSPS-QA-02.01_justification: Lockfiles: package-lock.json, uv.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, Gradle libs.
OSPS-QA-05.01_justification: dist/build/target are gitignored; CI publishes artifacts, does not commit them.
OSPS-QA-05.02_justification: Only expected binary is the Android Gradle wrapper JAR.
